items.title: 對話 · Dialogue
items.setting: 在咖啡店 · At the coffee shop

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 東賢，沒想到才兩年沒見，你已經是個大明星了。你演的戲，我都看了，我可以說是你的戲迷喔，快幫我簽個名吧！
paragraphs.simplified: 东賢，没想到才两年没见，你已经是个大明星了。你演的戏，我都看了，我可以说是你的戏迷喔，快帮我签个名吧！
paragraphs.english: Dongxian, I never thought that after only two years, you are already a big star! I've watched all the dramas you acted in; you could say I am a fan of yours! Quickly sign an autograph for me!

paragraphs.speaker: 東賢
paragraphs.traditional: 別這麼說，我還要繼續努力。
paragraphs.simplified: 别这么说，我还要继续努力。
paragraphs.english: Don't say that; I still need to keep working hard.

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 我覺得你已經很努力了。而且，你的中文進步得這麼快，是怎麼做到的？
paragraphs.simplified: 我觉得你已经很努力了。而且，你的中文进步得这么快，是怎么做到的？
paragraphs.english: I think you are already very hardworking. And your Chinese improved so fast, how did you manage that?

paragraphs.speaker: 東賢
paragraphs.traditional: 我把劇本裡要說的部分，都請老師錄了音，一有空就不斷地聽，不斷地練習。這樣子才學得好、學得快。
paragraphs.simplified: 我把剧本里要说的部分，都请老师录了音，一有空就不断地听，不断地练习。这样子才学得好、学得快。
paragraphs.english: I had the teacher record all the lines I needed to speak in the script, and whenever I had free time I listened and practiced continuously. That way I could learn well and fast.

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 這真是個好辦法，難怪你進步得這麼快。對了，你對未來有什麼計畫？
paragraphs.simplified: 这真是个好办法，难怪你进步得这么快。对了，你对未来有什么计画？
paragraphs.english: That's really a great method, no wonder you improved so quickly. By the way, what plans do you have for the future?

paragraphs.speaker: 東賢
paragraphs.traditional: 我從小就想當導演，腦子裡每天都想著這件事。有時連做夢都夢到自己拍電影的樣子，所以我打算明年開始學拍電影。
paragraphs.simplified: 我从小就想当导演，脑子里每天都想着这件事。有时连做梦都梦到自己拍电影的样子，所以我打算明年开始学拍电影。
paragraphs.english: Ever since I was little I wanted to be a director, and I think about this every day. Sometimes I even dream of myself filming movies, so I plan to start learning film directing next year.

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 導演？你長得這麼好看，身高也夠高，而且什麼角色都演得很好，不當演員多麼可惜啊！再說，觀眾也都很肯定你的表現。
paragraphs.simplified: 导演？你长得这么好看，身高也够高，而且什么角色都演得很好，不当演员多么可惜啊！再说，观众也都很肯定你的表现。
paragraphs.english: Director? You grew up looking so handsome, you are tall enough, and you act well in every role; what a pity not to be an actor! Besides, audiences really appreciate your performance.

paragraphs.speaker: 東賢
paragraphs.traditional: 導演還是可以演戲的。其實，要當好導演，不但得懂怎麼拍電影，也要教演員演戲，挑戰更大。
paragraphs.simplified: 导演还是可以演戏的。其实，要当好导演，不但得懂怎么拍电影，也要教演员演戏，挑战更大。
paragraphs.english: A director can still act. Actually, to be a good director, not only must one know how to make films, but one also has to guide actors; the challenge is even greater.

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 我聽說不少導演為了把電影拍好，連家都很少回去，有的還因為這樣離婚了。不過，我想只要你有實力，就不怕挑戰了。
paragraphs.simplified: 我听说不少导演为了把电影拍好，连家都很少回去，有的还因为这样离婚了。不过，我想只要你有实力，就不怕挑战了。
paragraphs.english: I heard quite a few directors rarely go home just to make good movies, and some even got divorced because of this. But I think as long as you have real capability, you won't fear challenges.

paragraphs.speaker: 東賢
paragraphs.traditional: 謝謝。今天能跟妳見面聊聊真好。
paragraphs.simplified: 谢谢。今天能跟你见面聊聊真好。
paragraphs.english: Thank you. It is really wonderful to meet and chat with you today.

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 那你以後別再跟我說，因為要演總統、石油公司大老闆什麼的，沒時間跟朋友聚一聚。不管多忙，你也要留點兒時間給朋友啊！
paragraphs.simplified: 那你以后别再跟我说，因为要演总统、石油公司大老闆什么的，没时间跟朋友聚一聚。不管多忙，你也要留点儿时间给朋友啊！
paragraphs.english: Then don't tell me later that you have no time to gather with friends because you need to play a president or oil tycoon. No matter how busy, leave some time for friends!

paragraphs.speaker: 東賢
paragraphs.traditional: 嗯！對了，也聊聊妳自己吧。妳學的是法律，以後要當律師吧？
paragraphs.simplified: 嗯！对了，也聊聊你自己吧。你学的是法律，以后要当律师吧？
paragraphs.english: Sure! By the way, let's talk about you. You study law, so you will become a lawyer in the future, right?

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 其實，我學法律是因為爸爸的要求。他希望我先當律師，將來有機會當上市長就更好了。
paragraphs.simplified: 其实，我学法律是因为爸爸的要求。他希望我先当律师，将来有机会当上市长就更好了。
paragraphs.english: Actually, I studied law because of my father's request. He hopes I first become a lawyer, and it would be even better if I have a chance to become mayor in the future.

paragraphs.speaker: 東賢
paragraphs.traditional: 所以當市長是妳的夢想嗎？
paragraphs.simplified: 所以当市长是你的梦想吗？
paragraphs.english: So becoming mayor is your dream?

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 唉，誰想當市長啊？不過，從小我爸媽什麼事都替我安排好了，雖然不喜歡，我也只能忍耐。
paragraphs.simplified: 唉，谁想当市长啊？不过，从小我爸妈什么事都替我安排好了，虽然不喜欢，我也只能忍耐。
paragraphs.english: Sigh, who wants to be mayor? But since childhood my parents arranged everything for me; even though I don't like it, I can only endure it.

paragraphs.speaker: 東賢
paragraphs.traditional: 其實，我們都不是小孩子了，自己的未來應該自己決定吧。
paragraphs.simplified: 其实，我们都不是小孩子了，自己的未来应该自己决定吧。
paragraphs.english: Actually, we are no longer children; our future should be decided by ourselves.

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 就是說嘛！但是我爸媽的想法太保守了，一時很難改變他們。
paragraphs.simplified: 就是说嘛！但是我爸妈的想法太保守了，一时很难改变他们。
paragraphs.english: Exactly! But my parents' mindset is too conservative; it's very difficult to change them all at once.

paragraphs.speaker: 東賢
paragraphs.traditional: 希望有一天，妳也能為了自己的夢想努力。
paragraphs.simplified: 希望有一天，你也能为了自己的梦想努力。
paragraphs.english: I hope that one day you can also strive for your own dream.

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 嗯，我們一起加油吧！
paragraphs.simplified: 嗯，我们一起加油吧！
paragraphs.english: Yeah, let's cheer each other on together!

items.title: 短文 · 追求夢想的東賢 · Dongxian Pursuing His Dream

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 電影是許多人生活中的休閒娛樂，但是要把一部電影拍好，可不是一件容易的事。
paragraphs.simplified: 电影是许多人生活中的休闲娱乐，但是要把一部电影拍好，可不是一件容易的事。
paragraphs.english: Movies are leisure entertainment in many people's lives, but making a good movie is by no means an easy task.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 東賢從小就對電影很有興趣，常常夢想自己能成為一位著名的導演。
paragraphs.simplified: 东賢从小就对电影很有兴趣，常常梦想自己能成为一位着名的导演。
paragraphs.english: Ever since childhood, Dongxian has been very interested in movies, often dreaming of becoming a famous director.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 為了追求這個夢想，東賢高中畢業後就決定到臺灣學習中文和電影製作。
paragraphs.simplified: 为了追求这个梦想，东賢高中毕业后就决定到台湾学习中文和电影制作。
paragraphs.english: In pursuit of this dream, after graduating from high school Dongxian decided to go to Taiwan to learn Chinese and filmmaking.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 起初，東賢的父母因為擔心他的未來而反對這個決定，希望他能留在韓國念商學。
paragraphs.simplified: 起初，东賢的父母因为担心他的未来而反对这个决定，希望他能留在韩国念商学。
paragraphs.english: Initially, Dongxian's parents opposed this decision because they worried about his future, hoping he would stay in Korea to study business.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 但東賢拿出自己的計畫書，向父母保證自己一定會認真學習、照顧好自己。
paragraphs.simplified: 但东賢拿出自己的计画书，向父母保证自己一定会认真学习、照顾好自己。
paragraphs.english: However, Dongxian presented his plan and guaranteed to his parents that he would study earnestly and take good care of himself.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 到了臺灣後，東賢一邊在大學念書，一邊在電影劇組實習，生活雖然忙碌但非常充實。
paragraphs.simplified: 到了台湾后，东賢一边在大学念书，一边在电影剧组实习，生活虽然忙碌但非常充实。
paragraphs.english: After arriving in Taiwan, Dongxian studied at university while interning on film sets; life was busy yet very fulfilling.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 東賢說：「追求夢想就像畫一張美麗的圖畫，只要不斷努力，就一定能畫出精彩的人生。」
paragraphs.simplified: 东賢说：「追求梦想就像画一张美丽的图画，只要不断努力，就一定能画出精彩的人生。」
paragraphs.english: Dongxian said: 'Pursuing a dream is like drawing a beautiful picture; as long as you work continuously, you will definitely paint a splendid life.'

items.title: 對話 · Dialogue
items.setting: 在便利商店 · At the convenience store

paragraphs.speaker: 尚恩
paragraphs.traditional: 朋子，臺灣的便利商店真的太神奇了！不僅能買東西，還能繳水電費、寄包裹，甚至還能買高鐵票！
paragraphs.simplified: 朋子，台湾的便利商店真的太神奇了！不仅能买东西，还能缴水电费、寄包裹，甚至还能买高铁票！
paragraphs.english: Tomoko, Taiwan's convenience stores are really amazing! Not only can you buy things, but you can also pay utility bills, send packages, and even buy high-speed rail tickets!

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 是啊，臺灣的超商密度可以說是世界第一呢。走幾步路就有一家，肚子餓了隨時都能買到熱騰騰的便當。
paragraphs.simplified: 是啊，台湾的超商密度可以说是世界第一呢。走几步路就有一家，肚子饿了随时都能买到热騰騰的便当。
paragraphs.english: Yes, Taiwan's convenience store density is practically number one in the world. There's one every few steps, and when you are hungry you can buy piping hot bento boxes anytime.

paragraphs.speaker: 尚恩
paragraphs.traditional: 我剛來臺灣的時候，看到店員一會兒煮咖啡，一會兒幫客人微波便當，一會兒又幫忙結帳，真是嚇了一跳！
paragraphs.simplified: 我刚来台湾的时候，看到店员一会儿煮咖啡，一会儿帮客人微波便当，一会儿又帮忙结帐，真是吓了一跳！
paragraphs.english: When I first came to Taiwan, seeing the clerk brewing coffee one moment, microwaving bento for customers the next, and helping check out right after, I was really astonished!

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 臺灣的超商店員樣樣精通，工作非常辛苦。
paragraphs.simplified: 台湾的超商店员样样精通，工作非常辛苦。
paragraphs.english: Taiwan's convenience store clerks master everything; their work is very hardworking.

paragraphs.speaker: 尚恩
paragraphs.traditional: 你今天也是來便利商店繳費的嗎？
paragraphs.simplified: 你今天也是来便利商店缴费的吗？
paragraphs.english: Did you come to the convenience store to pay bills today too?

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 不是，我是順便來拿網購的包裹，順便買杯冰美式咖啡。
paragraphs.simplified: 不是，我是顺便来拿网购的包裹，顺便买杯冰美式咖啡。
paragraphs.english: No, I came by the way to pick up an online shopping parcel, and pick up an iced Americano while I'm at it.

paragraphs.speaker: 尚恩
paragraphs.traditional: 我本來想回家煮晚餐，但今天加班太累了，我看就算了吧，在超商買個便當吃算了。
paragraphs.simplified: 我本来想回家煮晚餐，但今天加班太累了，我看就算了吧，在超商买个便当吃算了。
paragraphs.english: I originally wanted to go home and cook dinner, but I worked overtime and was too tired today. I guess never mind, I might as well just buy a bento at the convenience store.

paragraphs.speaker: 朋子
paragraphs.traditional: 哈哈，偶爾吃一次沒關係啦。走，我們一起進去吹冷氣選便當！
paragraphs.simplified: 哈哈，偶爾吃一次没关系啦。走，我们一起进去吹冷气选便当！
paragraphs.english: Haha, having it once in a while is fine. Come on, let's go inside, enjoy the air conditioning and pick a bento!

items.title: 短文 · 臺灣超商的生活樂趣 · Convenience Store Life in Taiwan

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 在臺灣，便利商店已經成為人們日常生活中不可缺少的一部分。
paragraphs.simplified: 在台湾，便利商店已经成为人们日常生活中不可缺少的一部分。
paragraphs.english: In Taiwan, convenience stores have become an indispensable part of people's daily lives.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 許多外國人來到臺灣，第一件印象深刻的事就是街頭巷尾隨處可見的超商。
paragraphs.simplified: 许多外国人来到台湾，第一件印象深刻的事就是街头巷尾随处可见的超商。
paragraphs.english: When many foreigners arrive in Taiwan, the first deep impression they have is the convenience stores seen everywhere on street corners.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 人們經過一整天忙碌的工作後，走進燈光明亮的便利商店，喝一杯香濃的咖啡，心情就放鬆了下來。
paragraphs.simplified: 人们经过一整天忙碌的工作后，走进灯光明亮的便利商店，喝一杯香浓的咖啡，心情就放松了下来。
paragraphs.english: After a busy day of work, people walk into the brightly lit convenience store and drink an aromatic coffee, relaxing their mood.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 現代人常用手機 App 來累積超商點數，兌換各種實用的生活用品或美食。
paragraphs.simplified: 现代人常用手机 App 来累积超商点数，兌换各种实用的生活用品或美食。
paragraphs.english: Modern people frequently use mobile apps to accumulate convenience store points and redeem various practical daily necessities or delicacies.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 便利商店不僅提供了極大的生活便利，更為現代都市人的生活增添了許多溫暖與樂趣。
paragraphs.simplified: 便利商店不仅提供了极大的生活便利，更为现代都市人的生活增添了许多温暖与乐趣。
paragraphs.english: Convenience stores not only provide immense daily convenience, but also add warmth and joy to the lives of modern urbanites.

items.title: 對話 · Dialogue
items.setting: 在百貨公司專櫃 · At the department store boutique

paragraphs.speaker: 芳草
paragraphs.traditional: 瑪莉，這家專櫃的洋裝看起來真漂亮，而且現在週年慶打八折呢！
paragraphs.simplified: 瑪莉，这家专柜的洋装看起来真漂亮，而且现在周年庆打八折呢！
paragraphs.english: Mary, this boutique's dress looks really beautiful, and there's a twenty percent discount for the anniversary sale!

paragraphs.speaker: 瑪莉
paragraphs.traditional: 是挺好看的，但買衣服一定要先試穿，試穿看看合不合身再決定。
paragraphs.simplified: 是挺好看的，但买衣服一定要先试穿，试穿看看合不合身再决定。
paragraphs.english: It's quite nice, but when buying clothes one must always try them on first to see if they fit well before deciding.

paragraphs.speaker: 芳草
paragraphs.traditional: 妳說得對。那我先進去試穿這件淺藍色的。
paragraphs.simplified: 你说得对。那我先进去试穿这件浅蓝色的。
paragraphs.english: You're right. Then I'll go inside first to try on this light blue one.

paragraphs.speaker: 芳草
paragraphs.traditional: 瑪莉，妳看這件怎麼樣？我覺得腰部有點緊，而且價格還是太高了。
paragraphs.simplified: 瑪莉，你看这件怎么样？我觉得腰部有点紧，而且价格还是太高了。
paragraphs.english: Mary, what do you think of this piece? I feel the waist is a bit tight, and the price is still too high.

paragraphs.speaker: 瑪莉
paragraphs.traditional: 與其買一件不舒服的名牌洋裝，不如到樓上的平價專櫃看看，那裡款式也很多。
paragraphs.simplified: 与其买一件不舒服的名牌洋装，不如到楼上的平价专柜看看，那里款式也很多。
paragraphs.english: Rather than buying an uncomfortable designer dress, it would be better to check the affordable section upstairs; there are many styles there too.

paragraphs.speaker: 芳草
paragraphs.traditional: 可是樓上的衣服材質怎麼樣？我什麼衣服都穿過，就是皮膚容易過敏，不能穿太粗糙的料子。
paragraphs.simplified: 可是楼上的衣服材质怎么样？我什么衣服都穿过，就是皮肤容易过敏，不能穿太粗糙的料子。
paragraphs.english: But how is the material of the clothes upstairs? I've worn all kinds of clothes, it's just that my skin is easily allergic, so I can't wear rough fabrics.

paragraphs.speaker: 瑪莉
paragraphs.traditional: 放心吧，樓上有幾個專櫃不僅質料柔軟，價格也很實在。
paragraphs.simplified: 放心吧，楼上有几个专柜不仅质料柔軟，价格也很实在。
paragraphs.english: Don't worry, several boutiques upstairs not only have soft materials, but their prices are very fair.

paragraphs.speaker: 芳草
paragraphs.traditional: 太好了！那我們別再這裡浪費時間了，趕快上樓去逛逛吧。
paragraphs.simplified: 太好了！那我们别再这里浪费时间了，赶快上楼去逛逛吧。
paragraphs.english: Awesome! Then let's not waste more time here, let's head upstairs quickly to look around.

items.title: 短文 · 貨比三家不吃虧 · Shopping Around to Get the Best Deal

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 在現代消費社會中，每個人都希望能「買得開心、用得放心」。
paragraphs.simplified: 在现代消费社会中，每个人都希望能「买得开心、用得放心」。
paragraphs.english: In modern consumer society, everyone hopes to 'buy with joy and use with peace of mind.'

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 俗話說「貨比三家不吃虧」，意思是在購買貴重物品前，多比較幾家商店的價格與品質，才不會吃虧上當。
paragraphs.simplified: 俗话说「货比三家不吃亏」，意思是在购买贵重物品前，多比较几家商店的价格与品质，才不会吃亏上当。
paragraphs.english: As the proverb says, 'Shop around and you won't suffer a loss,' meaning before purchasing expensive items, compare prices and quality across several stores so you won't get cheated.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 以前人們為了比價，得跑好幾家實體店鋪，費時又費力。
paragraphs.simplified: 以前人们为了比价，得跑好几家实体店鋪，费时又费力。
paragraphs.english: In the past, to compare prices people had to run around several physical shops, which was time-consuming and laborious.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 現在網路科技發達，大家不僅能透過比價網站輕鬆查詢價格，還能參考其他消費者的評價。
paragraphs.simplified: 现在网路科技发达，大家不仅能透过比价网站轻松查詢价格，还能参考其他消费者的评价。
paragraphs.english: Now with advanced internet technology, people not only can easily query prices via price-comparison sites, but also consult reviews from other consumers.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 消費者變得一次比一次聰明，商家也一年比一年更注重產品質量與售後服務。
paragraphs.simplified: 消费者变得一次比一次聪明，商家也一年比一年更注重产品质量与售后服务。
paragraphs.english: Consumers become smarter each time, and businesses focus more on product quality and customer service year after year.

items.title: 對話 · Dialogue
items.setting: 在佳琳家慶祝寶寶滿月 · Celebrating baby's full month at Jialin's house

paragraphs.speaker: 瑪莉
paragraphs.traditional: 芳草，恭喜佳琳生了這麼一對可愛的雙胞胎！今天滿月，家裡好熱鬧啊！
paragraphs.simplified: 芳草，恭喜佳琳生了这么一对可爱的双胞胎！今天满月，家里好热闹啊！
paragraphs.english: Mary: Fangcao, congratulations to Jialin for giving birth to such cute twins! Today is their full month; the house is so lively!

paragraphs.speaker: 芳草
paragraphs.traditional: 是啊！你看，好精緻的油飯和紅蛋啊！聞起來真香。
paragraphs.simplified: 是啊！你看，好精緻的油饭和红蛋啊！闻起来真香。
paragraphs.english: Yes! Look, what exquisite oily glutinous rice and red eggs! They smell so fragrant.

paragraphs.speaker: 瑪莉
paragraphs.traditional: 我今天特地親自挑選了兩套純棉的嬰兒服送給寶寶，希望他們健康長大。
paragraphs.simplified: 我今天特地亲自挑选了两套纯棉的婴儿服送给宝宝，希望他们健康长大。
paragraphs.english: I specially selected two sets of pure cotton baby clothes in person to give to the babies, hoping they grow up healthy.

paragraphs.speaker: 芳草
paragraphs.traditional: 妳真有心。在臺灣，送禮送紅包很有講究，金額通常要雙數才吉利。
paragraphs.simplified: 你真有心。在台湾，送礼送红包很有讲究，金額通常要双数才吉利。
paragraphs.english: You are truly thoughtful. In Taiwan, giving gifts and red envelopes is very nuanced; amounts are usually even numbers for good fortune.

paragraphs.speaker: 瑪莉
paragraphs.traditional: 剛才吃水果的時候，我想把梨子切開分給佳琳的婆婆，婆婆笑著跟我說不能分梨呢！
paragraphs.simplified: 刚才吃水果的时候，我想把梨子切开分给佳琳的婆婆，婆婆笑着跟我说不能分梨呢！
paragraphs.english: Just now when eating fruits, I wanted to slice the pear and share with Jialin's mother-in-law, and she smiled and told me we shouldn't share pears!

paragraphs.speaker: 芳草
paragraphs.traditional: 哈哈，因為「分梨」聽起來像「分離」，長輩通常會避開這個諧音。
paragraphs.simplified: 哈哈，因为「分梨」听起来像「分离」，长辈通常会避开这个諧音。
paragraphs.english: Haha, because 'sharing pears' sounds like 'parting ways'; elders usually avoid this homophone.

paragraphs.speaker: 瑪莉
paragraphs.traditional: 原來是這樣！我在禮品店找來找去，終於挑到滿意的禮物，今天學到了不少臺灣傳統習俗呢。
paragraphs.simplified: 原来是这样！我在礼品店找来找去，终于挑到满意的礼物，今天学到了不少台湾传统习俗呢。
paragraphs.english: So that's why! I searched back and forth in gift shops and finally picked a satisfying gift; I learned quite a few Taiwanese traditions today.

paragraphs.speaker: 芳草
paragraphs.traditional: 吃完飯後桌上的美味菜餚如果吃不完，我們還可以打包帶回家，不要浪費食物喔！
paragraphs.simplified: 吃完饭后桌上的美味菜餚如果吃不完，我们还可以打包带回家，不要浪费食物喔！
paragraphs.english: After eating, if the delicious dishes on the table aren't finished, we can also box them up to take home; don't waste food!

items.title: 短文 · 佳琳的信：坐月子與滿月 · Jialin's Letter: Confinement and Full Month

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 親愛的以晴，收到妳寄來的婚禮照片，看到妳美麗幸福的模樣，真替妳高興！
paragraphs.simplified: 亲爱的以晴，收到你寄来的婚礼照片，看到你美丽幸福的模样，真替你高兴！
paragraphs.english: Dear Yiqing, receiving the wedding photos you sent and seeing your beautiful, happy appearance, I am so joyful for you!

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 可惜因為我剛生完雙胞胎，正在坐月子，沒辦法親自飛到美國參加妳的婚禮。
paragraphs.simplified: 可惜因为我刚生完双胞胎，正在坐月子，没办法亲自飞到美国参加你的婚礼。
paragraphs.english: Unfortunately, because I just gave birth to twins and am doing postpartum confinement, I couldn't fly to America in person to attend your wedding.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 在臺灣，女人生產後都要坐月子一個月，每天吃麻油雞調養身體，也不能吹風。
paragraphs.simplified: 在台湾，女人生产后都要坐月子一个月，每天吃麻油鸡调养身体，也不能吹风。
paragraphs.english: In Taiwan, after giving birth women rest in confinement for a month, eating sesame oil chicken daily to nurse the body, and cannot catch drafts.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 這一個月裡，兩個寶寶整天哭個不停，吵著要喝奶，忙得我和先生連睡覺的時間都沒有。
paragraphs.simplified: 这一个月里，两个宝宝整天哭个不停，吵着要喝奶，忙得我和先生连睡觉的时间都没有。
paragraphs.english: During this month, the two babies cried incessantly all day, clamoring for milk, keeping my husband and me so busy that we didn't even have sleep time.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 今天孩子終於滿月了，家裡除了前來祝賀的親戚朋友以外，就是送給客人的油飯和蛋糕。
paragraphs.simplified: 今天孩子终于满月了，家里除了前来祝贺的亲戚朋友以外，就是送给客人的油饭和蛋糕。
paragraphs.english: Today the children finally completed their full month; in the house, besides visiting relatives and friends, there is only oily rice and cake for guests.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 雖然照顧雙胞胎的生活不是餵奶就是換尿布，但看著寶寶一天天長大，心裡感到無比的幸福。
paragraphs.simplified: 虽然照顾双胞胎的生活不是喂奶就是换尿布，但看着宝宝一天天长大，心里感到无比的幸福。
paragraphs.english: Although caring for twins means either feeding or diaper-changing, watching the babies grow day by day brings boundless happiness to the heart.

items.title: 對話 · Dialogue
items.setting: 颱風過後的早晨 · Morning after the typhoon

paragraphs.speaker: 芳草
paragraphs.traditional: 家豪，昨晚的颱風風雨好大，你家還好嗎？
paragraphs.simplified: 家豪，昨晚的台风风雨好大，你家还好吗？
paragraphs.english: Jiahao, last night's typhoon had such fierce wind and rain; is your home alright?

paragraphs.speaker: 家豪
paragraphs.traditional: 別提了，半夜風大得把路樹都吹倒了，我家甚至還停電了兩三個小時！
paragraphs.simplified: 别提了，半夜风大得把路树都吹倒了，我家甚至还停电了两三个小时！
paragraphs.english: Don't mention it; in the middle of the night the wind was so strong it blew down street trees, and my house even had a blackout for two or three hours!

paragraphs.speaker: 芳草
paragraphs.traditional: 幸好我家平時就準備了電池和手電筒，萬一停電也不用慌張。
paragraphs.simplified: 幸好我家平时就准备了电池和手电筒，万一停电也不用慌张。
paragraphs.english: Fortunately my family prepared batteries and flashlights in advance; in case of a power outage we don't need to panic.

paragraphs.speaker: 家豪
paragraphs.traditional: 我一連打了好幾通電話給住在花蓮的表哥，但電話一直打不通，真讓人擔心。
paragraphs.simplified: 我一连打了好几通电话给住在花莲的表哥，但电话一直打不通，真让人担心。
paragraphs.english: I called my cousin living in Hualien several times in a row, but couldn't get through; it really makes one worried.

paragraphs.speaker: 芳草
paragraphs.traditional: 我以為東部的情況會好一些，沒想到這次颱風在東部登陸，災情相當嚴重。
paragraphs.simplified: 我以为东部的情况会好一些，没想到这次台风在东部登陆，灾情相当严重。
paragraphs.english: I thought the situation in the east would be better, but unexpectedly this typhoon made landfall in the east, causing severe damage.

paragraphs.speaker: 家豪
paragraphs.traditional: 新聞說花蓮部分山區發生了土石流，甚至連對外聯絡的鐵路也被大水沖斷了。
paragraphs.simplified: 新闻说花莲部分山区发生了土石流，甚至连对外联络的铁路也被大水冲断了。
paragraphs.english: News reports say mudslides occurred in parts of Hualien's mountains, and even the railway connecting outside was washed out by floodwaters.

paragraphs.speaker: 芳草
paragraphs.traditional: 氣象局說後面可能還有另一個颱風形成，我們趁今天天氣放晴，也好趕快去超市補充足夠的乾糧和飲用水。
paragraphs.simplified: 气象局说后面可能还有另一个台风形成，我们趁今天天气放晴，也好赶快去超市补充足够的干糧和饮用水。
paragraphs.english: The weather bureau says another typhoon might form later; while the weather clears up today, it might be good for us to hurry to the supermarket to restock dry food and drinking water.

paragraphs.speaker: 家豪
paragraphs.traditional: 好！我們一起去超市採購防颱物資吧。
paragraphs.simplified: 好！我们一起去超市采购防台物资吧。
paragraphs.english: Great! Let's go to the supermarket together to purchase typhoon prevention supplies.

items.title: 短文 · 九二一地震與臺灣的韌性 · The 921 Earthquake and Taiwan's Resilience

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 臺灣位於環太平洋地震帶上，板塊運動活躍，因此地震發生的頻率相當高。
paragraphs.simplified: 台湾位于环太平洋地震带上，板块运动活躍，因此地震发生的频率相当高。
paragraphs.english: Taiwan is located on the Circum-Pacific seismic belt with active plate tectonics, hence earthquake frequency is quite high.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 一九九九年九月二十一日凌晨，臺灣中部發生了規模七點三的大地震，史稱「九二一地震」。
paragraphs.simplified: 一九九九年九月二十一日凌晨，台湾中部发生了规模七点三的大地震，史稱「九二一地震」。
paragraphs.english: In the early morning of September 21, 1999, a magnitude 7.3 earthquake struck central Taiwan, known historically as the '921 Earthquake.'

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 那一夜強烈的搖晃震碎了許多家庭的家園，結果造成了兩千多人不幸喪生，上萬棟房屋倒塌。
paragraphs.simplified: 那一夜强烈的摇晃震碎了许多家庭的家园，结果造成了两千多人不幸喪生，上万栋房屋倒塌。
paragraphs.english: That night's violent shaking shattered homes of many families, resulting unfortunately in more than 2,000 fatalities and thousands of collapsed houses.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 地震發生後，臺中與南投等重災區交通中斷，甚至連水電和通訊也完全癱瘓。
paragraphs.simplified: 地震发生后，台中与南投等重灾区交通中断，甚至连水电和通讯也完全癱瘓。
paragraphs.english: After the earthquake, transportation in hard-hit areas such as Taichung and Nantou was severed, and even water, electricity, and telecommunications were completely paralyzed.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 面對巨大的天災，全臺灣人民發揮了「有錢出錢、有力出力」的精神，國內外救援隊伍也迅速投入救災。
paragraphs.simplified: 面对巨大的天灾，全台湾人民发挥了「有钱出钱、有力出力」的精神，国内外救援队伍也迅速投入救灾。
paragraphs.english: Confronting this massive natural disaster, all Taiwanese displayed the spirit of 'contributing money and labor,' and rescue teams from home and abroad rapidly joined disaster relief.

paragraphs.speaker: 旁白
paragraphs.traditional: 車站以南的中部災民在社會各界的溫暖支持下，齊心協力重建家園，展現了無比堅韌的生命力。
paragraphs.simplified: 车站以南的中部灾民在社会各界的温暖支持下，齐心协力重建家园，展现了无比坚韌的生命力。
paragraphs.english: Victims in central Taiwan south of the station rebuilt their homes with united efforts under warm support from all sectors of society, demonstrating immense resilience.
